baseTemplate.title: AI Orchestration Co-op Student - BizFlow Platform
baseTemplate.description:
Join TAURUS AI CORP's BizFlow AI Orchestration team as a Co-op Student and gain hands-on experience in AI agent development, business automation, and intelligent orchestration systems. Work alongside experienced engineers to build and deploy AI-powered solutions that drive real business value.

**About BizFlow:**
BizFlow is our flagship AI orchestration platform, managing 21,405+ AI agents and MCP tools across multiple business domains. You'll work on cutting-edge technology that powers intelligent routing, multi-agent coordination, and enterprise automation.

**Key Responsibilities:**
- Assist in developing and testing AI agent workflows
- Contribute to MCP (Model Context Protocol) server integrations
- Help optimize business process automation systems
- Participate in code reviews and technical discussions
- Document technical specifications and user guides
- Support deployment and monitoring of AI systems

**Learning Opportunities:**
- Gain expertise in AI orchestration and multi-agent systems
- Learn about enterprise automation and business intelligence
- Work with modern Python, FastAPI, and cloud technologies
- Understand MCP protocol and agent communication patterns
- Experience production-grade software development practices

**Duration:** 4-8 months
**Start Date:** Flexible (typically January, May, or September)
**Location:** Remote/Hybrid options available
requirements: Currently enrolled in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or related program
Interest in AI/ML and automation technologies
Ability to work independently and in a team
Strong written and verbal communication skills
preferredQualifications: Experience with FastAPI or similar web frameworks
Knowledge of AI/ML concepts and libraries
Familiarity with cloud platforms (AWS, GCP, Azure)
Experience with Git and version control
Understanding of REST APIs and microservices
